services.desc: In the heart of an ancient, mist-shrouded forest lies an abandoned mansion with a dark history. This mansion, once the grand home of Lady Lilith, has stood silent and foreboding for over a century. The locals speak in hushed tones about the mysterious disappearances and eerie occurrences that have plagued the area since her untimely demise. Legend has it that Lady Lilith was a woman of extraordinary beauty and intelligence, but she was also deeply involved in the occult. Her fascination with dark magic led her down a path from which she never returned. One stormy night, she vanished without a trace, leaving behind a legacy of fear and superstition.
